03 / Open by design

A little technology.
A lot worth keeping.

Inspired by the stories that linger after someone leaves the room. Ghostlight helps you revisit what was written, with no invented memories and no imitation of a person's voice.

01

Keep the words.

Add a memory, import an archive, or explore the fictional examples. You choose whether to save it in your browser.

02

Find the meaning.

An open-source embedding model compares your question with your archive, entirely on your device.

03

Return to the source.

Read the original passages, export them, or take the code and make this little lantern your own.

Your memories and search text stay in your browser. The app downloads model and runtime files when you initialize AI; it sends no archive text to an inference service.
